Bash(rm -f /tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db /tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db-wal /tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db-shm
MASTER_KEY=$\(openssl rand -base64 32 2>/dev/null || head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64\)
echo "master key: $MASTER_KEY"
export OPENPANEL__DATABASE__MASTER_KEY="$MASTER_KEY"
OPENPANEL__SERVER__PORT=18446 OPENPANEL__DATABASE__URL=/tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db RUST_LOG=info ./target/debug/openpanel serve 2>/tmp/openpanel-test/server.log &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 3
echo "--- migrations applied? ---"
grep -E "applying migration" /tmp/openpanel-test/server.log
echo "--- health ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18446/health
echo ""
OPENPANEL__DATABASE__URL=/tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db ./target/debug/openpanel user create --username admin --email admin@example.com --password 'correct horse battery staple' --role owner > /dev/null
LOGIN_RESP=$\(curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18446/api/v1/identity/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username_or_email":"admin","password":"correct horse battery staple"}'\)
TOKEN=$\(echo "$LOGIN_RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print\(json.load\(sys.stdin\).get\('token',''\)\)"\)
echo "--- list databases \(should be empty\) ---"
curl -s -w "\\nstatus: %{http_code}\\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:18446/api/v1/databases
echo "--- get nonexistent database ---"
curl -s -w "\\nstatus: %{http_code}\\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:18446/api/v1/databases/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
echo "--- create database \(mysql missing → 500\) ---"
curl -s -w "\\nstatus: %{http_code}\\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18446/api/v1/databases -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"owner_username":"admin","suffix":"app"}'
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
unset OPENPANEL__DATABASE__MASTER_KEY
echo done)
